headline: Island Front Flares at Fishermans Row as Central Clashes Endure
war_summary: Since the last dispatch, combat intensity has flared sharply on the western waters of Fishermans Row, where eight base ownership changes in two hours around Eidolo and Arcadia have left a strongpoint unresolved in no-man's-land. Across the central lines, Linn of Mercy continues to see violent back-and-forth clashes, logging six transitions over the last two hours primarily at The First Coin alongside sustained high casualties. Weathered Expanse remains heavily contested with three recent base events and over six hundred casualties in two hours as fighting presses near Wightwalk and Frostmarch. Further south, Marban Hollow recorded three fresh shifts at Mox, while direct base turnover temporarily cooled across Stlican Shelf, Stonecradle, and Callahan's Passage despite ongoing troop movements. Meanwhile, in Viper Pit, high casualty rates persist following the earlier Colonial capture of Blackthroat, maintaining pressure across the northern approaches.
